what: Mock API harness maintained by the Zibby frontend-specialist agent. This branch is NEVER merged: it is restored into the worktree at the start of every run so the mock layer is built once and stays out of feature pull requests.
startCommand: nohup setsid -f bash -lc 'cd /workspace/vikunja-app/frontend && exec node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config vite.mock.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173 > /tmp/devserver.log 2>&1 < /dev/null' >/tmp/devserver-launch.log 2>&1 &
